We had such a great experience! The entire team was welcoming, attentive, and genuinely kind from the moment we walked in. A special shout‑out to Meklit, who went above and beyond for our 4‑year‑old son — patient, accommodating, and incredibly thoughtful. It made our visit feel personal and memorable.

The food was just as impressive. The smash potatoes are an absolute must‑try — crispy, flavourful, and addictive. The nachos and wings were also delicious, perfectly seasoned, and great for sharing.

Highly recommend stopping by if you’re looking for great food paired with truly exceptional customer service.

Evan absolutely slapped. Best Baby Guinness I’ve had in a long time. Friendly, fast service, great banter, and clearly knows what he’s doing behind the bar. If you’re lucky enough to get served by Evan, order a Baby Guinness and thank me later. 5/5.

LOCAL PUBLIC EATERY (LPE) is my favourite Pub. I had a great time, as always, this week at their LEASIDE location. Enjoyed the food and wine. Large Menu to choose from. Service was outstanding!! Our server Diana looked after me and my guest. I would highly recommend you trying out LOCAL PUBLIC EATERY. They have 3 locations in Toronto now. Great food and drinks. It’s the people who work there make it special. I will visit soon.

Toddler got lot of attention and toys to play with as well. Server Kalypsa was outstanding and really took good care to make us feel at home. I sent a thank you message to the kitchen also for all those who were cooking that afternoon. Manager Ricki made sure we were all looked after. Others who touched the service on our table were Jackie N., Deanna, Amy, Nicola and Alyssa. What a wonderful experience. What a wonderful team. My compliments to all of them. Will certainly visit again soon. Thank you !!!

The food here is amazing. I ordered something simple: the breakfast sandwich. I didn't expect much because it's just an egg and bacon sandwich. But, as is known in the culinary industry, the simplest dishes are the greatest test of skill. The egg was cooked to perfection. The bacon was crispy but not overcooked. The sauce was flavourful. Even the side salad struck the perfect balance between sharp cheese and aromatic peppercorns. The food was a delightful pairing with my $5 house lager, which was light and very drinkable.

Our server, Ewin, always made sure we had everything we needed. He even remembered everyone's name in a table of 6! He checked in regularly so I could refill my alcohol at a good pace. His friendly and personable service brightened up the experience.

Finally, the music played here is just one banger after another.  I normally don't like loud music but I loved every song that played here. It makes for an exciting but subtle background to the lively conversation you're surely having with your friends.

I will definitely be coming back.
